substitutionTest.rule: Standing surviving-sentence count, run for every section on coordinator instruction before any pairing test
substitutionTest.note: Standing procedure, run before any pairing test: 12 of 15 testable baseline sentences of four or more words survive verbatim in the current text after punctuation normalization. The count is nonzero, so the section is not in substitution mode and the pairing tests apply. The shortfall is dominated by the recorded coda-scaffold removal, the linked reading-path lines, and ledger-bounded sentences whose interiors changed by one modality word.

findings.summary: The section was replaced, not condensed.

evidence.shipped: 407 words, of which 2 of 11 testable sentences survive verbatim from the baseline.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, recorded in editorial/evidence/reviews/volumes/volume-06/2026-07-09-production-pass/compression.md as a 39.8 percent reduction.

Diagnosed by normalising punctuation and case and testing every current sentence for verbatim presence in the immutable baseline.

findings.summary: The oldest and most seductive lie, the section's central figure, lost its three demonstrations.

evidence.baseline: Fell the orchard and enter the timber as profit. Drain the aquifer and call the harvest growth. Burn through soil and trust and attention, and write every loss in the ledger as a gain.
evidence.shipped: An economy may fell an orchard and count the timber as income, drain an aquifer and count the harvest as growth, or consume soil, trust, and attention while keeping those losses outside its books.

findings.diagnosis: The retention limb applies. The three cases escalate from a visible thing to an invisible one, and folding them into a single sentence about what an economy may do removes the accumulation that makes the third case land. The lie is also named in the baseline and unnamed in the shipped text.

findings.summary: The extractive substrate's account of itself lost the loan and the note.

evidence.baseline: We have lived long enough upon the extractive substrate to mistake it for reality itself; but it was always a loan drawn against a principal we did not earn, and in our time the note is being called.

findings.diagnosis: The note being called is the section's only statement about the present tense, and the principal we did not earn returns to the spending a principal it insists on calling income two sentences earlier. Removing it leaves the argument historical and takes the urgency out of it.

findings.summary: The case for coherence lost its refusal.

evidence.baseline: The case for coherence is not that it is nobler. It is that it is the only ground on which a civilization complex enough to endanger itself can continue to stand.
evidence.shipped: The case for coherence is that a civilization capable of endangering itself needs arrangements that restore the conditions on which it depends.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.3, applied to the not X but Y shape.
findings.diagnosis: The rejected reading, that coherence is the morally better option, is the one most readers arrive holding and the one the whole series works to displace, so 4.3's retention limb applies. The only ground on which a civilization can continue to stand is also the claim, and needs arrangements that restore conditions is a recommendation.

findings.summary: The baseline's colon was demoted to a comma, and precisely was swapped for exactly, neither under any recorded decision.

evidence.baseline: This is its oldest and most seductive lie: to record the depletion of a thing as the earning of it... It feels like prosperity precisely because it is consuming something it neither made nor can replace...
evidence.shipped: This is its oldest and most seductive lie, to record the depletion of a thing as the earning of it... It feels like prosperity exactly because...

findings.authorizedBy: Nothing recorded. Generation A's punctuation note covers the em dashes only.
findings.diagnosis: The colon is the baseline's own mark and it specifies the lie; the comma is the slack repair R-PUNCT-STRUCT calls the most common wrong answer, and no prohibited mark stood there. Precisely is on no reduce list and modifies the causal claim exactly; the same unauthorized swap appears in What This Is For, so the two are one habit recorded twice at its two sites. Both restored by this audit.

debtImpact.note: Something closer to a law of lasting systems is rendered as something closer to a constraint on what can last, which keeps the strength of the claim and drops the assertion that a law has been established.
No moral claim about historical extraction beyond the baseline's own is restored.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Four em dashes. One was appositive and became a comma, one became a period before the constraint claim, and a paired set enclosing the off-book entries was rebuilt so the entries follow a colon.

The two kinds and the ending distinction, the season and the age, the principal called income, the three demonstrations of the lie, the inheritance converted into receipts, the entries kept off the books, the loan and the note being called, and the refusal that coherence is merely nobler.
